sections.appearance: Mari has waist length, orange hair with bangs on each side. A loose ponytail, ending in a braid is tied on her right side with a gold ribbon, hanging directly next to mentioned bangs, and a flower ornament towards the top. She has a pair of cat ears, with white fluff inside. She has sky blue eyes. Halo ==== Her halo is made up of a six petalled flower, surrounded by a circle. Said circle has six triangles sticking out, evenly spread. Her halo has a golden yellow gradient Uniform ==== Her uniform consists of a long, white robe, a black monastic scapular with long sleeves, held by a golden, cross-symbol harness with blue ribbons. The scapular has golden knots decorating the bottom. A golden bow at the lower back, golden patterned armbands, and gold ribbons around the cuffs. She has a black veil with a white underside over her head, with a golden headband. She wears black, flat heel, closed toe shoes with gold buttons, and soles, white socks, and white ankle wraps, with gold ribbons. Firearm ==== thumb|Piety|353x353px She uses a Desert Eagle Mk. XIX L6 pistol with a Black and Titanium Gold finish and custom gold flower accents on the slide. A peach fur ball with a gold bird strap is attached on the grip.

sections.personality: Mari is exceptionally humble and soft-spoken, with a strong desire to help others however she can. Because of this, she often overlooks her own personal limits. Just as strong is her spirituality, as she strives hard to uphold and apply the teachings and values of the Sisterhood to herself. When it comes to Sensei however, she is often on the receiving end of help, which has stirred possessive feelings she considers to be undivine. In spite of this, she is still capable of decisive action when needed, especially when Trinity as a whole is under threat. She had willingly relayed Hanako's suspicions to the Sisterhood in the leadup to Mika's coup, and was willing to steal a motorbike to prevent Sakurako and Mine from coming to blows.
